dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a smooth concave curvature from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a wide pixel radius at the maximum vertical point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 40-degree slope relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of base chord length to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex arc with a medium radius defining the anterior forehead region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak with a low length-to-thickness ratio extending from the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse interior angle at the transition from the melon to the dorsal rostrum line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small V-shaped notch on the lower third of the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; multiple irregular light-toned depigmentation patches on the lateral surface of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast caustic light patterns visible across the dorsal and mid-lateral surfaces.
